note: Task 3.7: synthetic 'archive' chats of the sample store (sample_inventory.csv, sample_store.json zones, knowledge_testset.json store info) as a staff member handled them. Each customer message is replayed through the real bot; the bot's turn passes when it takes the same action as the staff reply (`action`, or one of `any_of`) and its reply contains one alternative from each inner list of `include` and nothing from `exclude`. Actions: ask (asks for missing info), summary (order total, waiting for confirm), order_placed, answer, handoff (to the owner). When the staff broke a hard rule (gave a discount, invented a fee), the expected action follows the rule and `note` says why. Synthetic data only.
